name: StonkBrokers Safe Launch
description: Token launch platform using bonding curves and anti-snipe launch windows, with launch proceeds graduating into permanently locked DEX liquidity

methodology.Volume: Safe Launch / Stonklauncher window buys AND sells on every pad generation (V1 ETH, V1 quoted, V2, r2 — buy = tax-inclusive quoteIn/ethIn, sell = quoteOut/ethOut + taxPaid, quote-token denominated on quoted/WETH lanes) + anti-snipe WallBought.ethIn + StonkCurvePool Trade.quoteAmount on the bonding-curve launcher.
methodology.Fees: Safe Launch / Stonklauncher snipe tax on window buys and sells across all pad generations (16.5% creator / 16.5% protocol / 50% locked-LP or ICO Bonus / 17% StockBooster + Clock In Card referrers); the anti-snipe fair-launch snipe tax (time-decay tax on launch-curve buys, 90% StockBooster / 10% launch dev); and StonkCurvePool 1% trade fees (33/33/33 waterfall).
methodology.Revenue: The 16.5% protocol leg of the Safe Launch / Stonklauncher snipe tax and 33.34% of bonding-curve trade fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 16.5% of the Safe Launch / Stonklauncher snipe tax → protocol accrual; 33.34% of bonding-curve trade fees → protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Safe Launch tax legs to the launch creator (16.5%), StockBooster + Clock In Card referrers (17%), and the permanently locked LP reserve / ICO Bonus (50%); 90% of the anti-snipe launch tax → StockBooster dividends and 10% → launch dev; bonding-curve creator (33.33%) + StonkBrokers Directed Clock In / pot (33.33%).

Fees.Anti-snipe launch tax (time-decay snipe: Time-decay snipe tax on anti-snipe fair-launch curve buys (99% at launch, falling 1%/minute over a 99-minute window; WallBought.taxPaid). Split 90% StockBooster / 10% launch dev, pushed live per trade.

Split 16.5% launch creator / 16.5% protocol / 50% locked-LP reserve or ICO Bonus / 17% StockBooster + Clock In Card referrers, snapshotted per launch. Quoted-lane amounts are in the quote token.
